license_required.quote: Only licensees may issue a report on financial statements of any person, firm, organization or governmental unit or offer to render or render any attest service.

issuing_authority.quote: "Board", the Missouri state board of accountancy established under section 326.259 or its predecessor pursuant to prior law

age_minimum.quote: Has attained the age of eighteen years

degree_required.value: 150 semester hours including a baccalaureate or higher degree with accounting concentration
degree_required.quote: has at least one hundred fifty semester hours of college education, including a baccalaureate or higher degree conferred by an accredited college or university recognized by the board, with the total educational program including an accounting concentration or equivalent

accrediting_body.value: accredited college or university recognized by the board
accrediting_body.quote: baccalaureate or higher degree conferred by an accredited college or university recognized by the board

required.quote: Has had one year of experience.

duration.quote: Has had one year of experience.

kind.value: accounting, attest, compilation, management advisory, financial advisory, tax or consulting skills including governmental accounting, budgeting or auditing
kind.quote: Experience shall be verified by a licensee and shall include any type of service or advice involving the use of accounting, attest, compilation, management advisory, financial advisory, tax or consulting skills including governmental accounting, budgeting or auditing.

exams.name: Uniform Certified Public Accountant Examination
exams.notes: Board may use all or any part of the AICPA Uniform CPA Examination and Advisory Grading Service
exams.quote: The board may make use of all or any part of the Uniform Certified Public Accountant Examination and Advisory Grading Service of the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants

interval_years.quote: Licenses shall be initially issued and renewed for periods of not more than three years and shall expire on the renewal date following issuance or renewal.

required.quote: Each licensee shall participate in a program of learning designed to maintain professional competency.

hours_per_period.quote: Shall not require the completion of more than one hundred twenty hours of continuing education or its equivalent in any three-year period

period_years.quote: Shall not require the completion of more than one hundred twenty hours of continuing education or its equivalent in any three-year period

available.quote: An individual whose principal place of business, domicile, or residency is not in this state and who holds a valid and unrestricted license to practice public accounting from any state which the board or its designee has determined by rule to be in substantial equivalence with the licensure requirements of this chapter...shall have all the privileges of licensees of this state without the need to obtain a license

requirements.value: Must hold a valid and unrestricted license from a substantially equivalent state, or have individually substantially equivalent qualifications. No notice, registration, or fee required. Out-of-state CPAs consent to board jurisdiction and disciplinary authority.
requirements.quote: shall be presumed to have qualifications substantially equivalent to this state's requirements and shall have all the privileges of licensees of this state without the need to obtain a license or to otherwise notify or register with the board or pay any fee.

regulatory_model.quote: Only licensees may issue a report on financial statements of any person, firm, organization or governmental unit or offer to render or render any attest service.

title_protection.quote: Only certified public accountants shall use or assume the title certified public accountant, or the abbreviation CPA or any other title, designation, words, letters, abbreviation, sign, card or device tending to indicate that such person is a certified public accountant.

scope_protection.quote: Only licensees may issue a report on financial statements of any person, firm, organization or governmental unit or offer to render or render any attest service.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of controlled substances or alcohol to an extent that impairs ability to perform professional duties
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Use of any controlled substance, as defined in chapter 195, or alcoholic beverage to an extent that the use impairs a person's ability to perform the work of any profession licensed or regulated by this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Final adjudication or guilty plea for a crime related to the profession, involving fraud/dishonesty/violence, or moral turpitude
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The person has been finally adjudicated and found guilty, or entered a plea of guilty or nolo contendere, in a criminal prosecution under the laws of any state or of the United States, for any offense reasonably related to the qualifications, functions or duties of any profession licensed or regulated pursuant to this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of fraud, deception, misrepresentation or bribery in securing a certificate, permit, or license or permission to take an examination
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Use of fraud, deception, misrepresentation or bribery in securing any certificate, permit or license issued pursuant to this chapter or in obtaining permission to take any examination given or required pursuant to this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining or attempting to obtain fees or compensation by fraud, deception or misrepresentation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Obtaining or attempting to obtain any fee, charge, tuition or other compensation by fraud, deception or misrepresentation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Incompetency, misconduct, gross negligence, fraud, misrepresentation or dishonesty in performing professional duties
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Incompetency, misconduct, gross negligence, fraud, misrepresentation or dishonesty in the performance of the functions or duties of any profession licensed or regulated by this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of, or assisting others to violate, any provision of the chapter or lawful rules adopted under it
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of, or assisting or enabling any person to violate, any provision of this chapter or any lawful rule or regulation adopted pursuant to this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Impersonating a certificate or permit holder, or allowing another to use one's certificate, permit, or diploma
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Impersonation of any person holding a certificate or permit or allowing any person to use his or her certificate or permit or diploma from any school

disciplinary_grounds.description: Revocation, suspension, or other disciplinary action against the licensee by another state, territory, federal agency, or country
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Revocation, suspension, restriction, modification, limitation, reprimand, warning, censure, probation or other final disciplinary action against the holder of or applicant for a license or other right to practice any profession regulated by this chapter by another state, territory, federal agency or country

disciplinary_grounds.description: Final adjudication of insanity or incompetency by a court of competent jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A person is finally adjudged insane or incompetent by a court of competent jurisdiction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Assisting or enabling an ineligible person to practice or offer to practice accountancy
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Assisting or enabling any person to practice or offer to practice accountancy pursuant to this chapter who is not eligible to practice pursuant to this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Issuance of a license or permit based upon a material mistake of fact
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Issuance of a license or permit based upon a material mistake of fact

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to display a valid certificate, license, or permit as required
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to display a valid certificate, license, or permit required by this chapter or any rule promulgated pursuant to this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any professional trust or confidence
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of any professional trust or confidence

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of false, misleading or deceptive advertising or solicitation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Use of any advertisement or solicitation which is false, misleading or deceptive to the general public or persons to whom the advertisement or solicitation is primarily directed

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of professional standards or rules of professional conduct applicable to the accountancy profession
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of professional standards or rules of professional conduct applicable to the accountancy profession as promulgated by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with any final court order enforcing a board subpoena
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to comply with any final order of a court of competent jurisdiction enforcing a subpoena or subpoena duces tecum from the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with any final order of the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to comply with any final order of the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to maintain documentation evidencing compliance with continuing professional education requirements
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to maintain documentation evidencing compliance with the board's continuing professional education requirements

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to maintain compliance with requirements for issuance or renewal of certificate, license, or permit, or to report changes to the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure, on the part of a holder of a certificate, license or permit pursuant to section 326.280 or 326.289, to maintain compliance with the requirements for issuance or renewal of such certificate, license, permit or provisional license or to report changes to the board pursuant to sections 326.280 to 326.289

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making any false or misleading statement or verification in support of another person's application for a certificate, license, or permit
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making any false or misleading statement or verification in support of an application for a certificate, license or permit filed by another.

definition_quote.value: Performing or offering to perform for an enterprise, client or potential client one or more services involving the use of accounting or auditing skills, or one or more management advisory or consulting services, or the preparation of tax returns or the furnishing of advice on tax matters by a person, firm, limited liability company or professional corporation using the title "C.P.A." or "P.A."
definition_quote.quote: Performing or offering to perform for an enterprise, client or potential client one or more services involving the use of accounting or auditing skills, or one or more management advisory or consulting services, or the preparation of tax returns or the furnishing of advice on tax matters by a person, firm, limited liability company or professional corporation using the title "C.P.A." or "P.A."

methods_authorized.quote: Performing or offering to perform for an enterprise, client or potential client one or more services involving the use of accounting or auditing skills, or one or more management advisory or consulting services, or the preparation of tax returns or the furnishing of advice on tax matters

value: Audit or other engagement in accordance with Statements on Auditing Standards (SAS)
Examination of prospective financial information in accordance with SSAE
Engagement in accordance with PCAOB auditing standards and rules
Review of a financial statement in accordance with SSARS
Examination, review, or agreed upon procedures engagement in accordance with SSAE
attest_services_types.quote: Any audit or other engagement to be performed in accordance with the Statements on Auditing Standards (SAS); Any examination of prospective financial information to be performed in accordance with the Statements on Standards for Attestation Engagements (SSAE); Any engagement to be performed in accordance with the auditing standards and rules of the Public Company Accounting Oversight Board (PCAOB); Any review of a financial statement to be performed in accordance with the Statements on Standards for Accounting and Review Services (SSARS); or Any examination, review, or agreed upon procedures engagement to be performed in accordance with the SSAE

compilation_services_authorized.quote: "Compilation", providing a service to be performed in accordance with Statements on Standards for Accounting and Review Services (SSARS) that is presented in the form of financial statements information that is the representation of management (owners) without undertaking to express any assurance on the statements

education_semester_hours_required.quote: has at least one hundred fifty semester hours of college education, including a baccalaureate or higher degree conferred by an accredited college or university recognized by the board

exam_sit_hours_minimum.quote: Provide proof that the applicant has completed at least one hundred twenty semester hours of college education at an accredited college or university recognized by the board, with an accounting concentration or equivalent as determined by the board by rule

practice_privilege_no_notice_required.quote: shall have all the privileges of licensees of this state without the need to obtain a license or to otherwise notify or register with the board or pay any fee

value: Consent to personal and subject matter jurisdiction and disciplinary authority of the board
Comply with this chapter and the board's rules
Cease offering or rendering professional services if the license from any state is no longer valid or unrestricted
Appointment of the state board that issued the individual's license as agent for service of process
practice_privilege_consent_conditions.quote: To the personal and subject matter jurisdiction and disciplinary authority of the board; To comply with this chapter and the board's rules; That in the event the license from any state is no longer valid or unrestricted, the individual shall cease offering or rendering professional services in this state individually and on behalf of a firm; and To the appointment of the state board that issued the individual's license as his or her agent upon whom process may be served

attest_services_require_firm_permit.quote: An individual who has been granted the privilege to practice under this section who performs attest or compilation services shall comply with the provisions of section 326.289.

firm_majority_cpa_ownership_required.quote: A simple majority of the ownership of the firm, in terms of financial interests and voting rights of all partners, officers, principals, shareholders, members or managers, belongs to licensees who are licensed in some state

nonlicensee_firm_owners_permitted.quote: Any certified public accounting firm may include owners who are not licensees provided that

peer_review_required_for_firm_renewal.quote: The board shall require by rule, as a condition to the renewal of permits, that firms undergo, no more frequently than once every three years, peer reviews conducted in a manner as the board shall specify.

peer_review_max_frequency_years.quote: no more frequently than once every three years, peer reviews conducted in a manner as the board shall specify

peer_review_records_privileged.quote: The proceedings, records and workpapers of the board and any peer review subjected to the board process shall be privileged and shall not be subject to discovery, subpoena or other means of legal process or introduction into evidence at any civil action, arbitration, administrative proceeding or board proceeding.

inactive_license_status_available.quote: Licensees granted an exception by the board shall place the word "inactive" adjacent to their certified public accountant title on any business card, letterhead or any other document or device

out_of_state_firm_no_office_exemption.quote: Any firm that does not have an office in this state may offer or perform attest or compilation services in this state without a valid permit only if it meets each of the following requirements

office_supervision_by_licensed_cpa_requi.quote: An applicant for initial issuance or renewal of a permit to practice shall register each office of the firm within this state with the board and show that all attest and compilation services rendered in this state are under the charge of a licensee.

attest_report_signer_competency_requirem.quote: Any licensee who is responsible for supervising attest services, or signs or authorizes someone to sign the licensee's report on the financial statements on behalf of the firm, shall meet competency requirements as determined by the board by rule

client_confidentiality_privilege.quote: a licensee pursuant to this chapter shall not voluntarily disclose information communicated to the licensee by the client relating to and in connection with services rendered to the client by the licensee. The information shall be privileged and confidential

working_papers_ownership_by_licensee.quote: all statements, records, schedules, working papers and memoranda made by a licensee...shall be and remain the property of the licensee in the absence of an express agreement between the licensee and the client to the contrary

commission_prohibition_during_attest.quote: A licensee shall not for a commission recommend or refer to a client any product or service...when the licensee also performs for that client: Attest services

contingent_fee_prohibition_during_attest.quote:
A licensee shall not:
(a) Perform for a contingent fee any professional services for, or receive a fee from, a client for whom the licensee or the licensees's firm performs:
a. Attest services

safe_harbor_disclaimer_language_for_nonl.quote: Nonlicensees shall not use language in any statement relating to the financial affairs of a person or entity that is conventionally used by certified public accountants in reports on financial statements. Nonlicensees may use the following safe harbor language

foreign_accountant_practice_exception.quote: None of the foregoing provisions of this section shall apply to a person or firm holding a certification, designation, degree or license granted in a foreign country entitling the holder to engage in the practice of public accounting or its equivalent in the country whose activities in this state are limited to the provision of professional services to persons or firms who are residents of, governments of, or business entities of the country in which the person holds the entitlement

single_act_evidence_sufficient.quote: In any such action evidence of the commission of a single act prohibited by this chapter shall be sufficient to justify an injunction or a conviction without evidence of a general course of conduct.

firm_corrective_action_period_for_owners.quote: Firms which fall out of compliance with the provisions of this section due to changes in firm ownership or personnel after receiving or renewing a permit shall take corrective action to bring the firm back into compliance as quickly as possible. The board may grant a reasonable period of time for a firm to take such corrective action.

firm_permit_required_for_attest_services.quote: No licensee shall perform attest or compilation services through any certified public accounting firm that does not hold a valid permit issued under section 326.289.

client_records_return_obligation.quote: A licensee shall furnish to a client or former client, upon request and reasonable notice: A copy of the licensee's working papers to the extent that the working papers include records that would ordinarily constitute part of the client's records and are not otherwise available to the client; and Any accounting or other records belonging to, or obtained from or on behalf of, the client
